archetype: Archetype 2 (Performance Pro) / Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) Hybrid - Technical Audiophile

typography.font_install_instructions: Add Google Fonts imports for Outfit, IBM Plex Sans, and IBM Plex Mono to the global CSS.

hierarchy.data_labels: text-xs font-medium tracking-[0.1em] text-zinc-400 uppercase font-mono

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Control Room Grid - high density, technical precision, visible 1px borders. No soft shadows.
spacing_and_layout.container: Mobile-first responsive layout (w-full max-w-md mx-auto h-[100dvh] overflow-hidden flex flex-col bg-[#0A0A0A] border-x border-white/10) to emulate a mobile app view.
spacing_and_layout.borders: 1px solid border-white/10 for all panels, hard technical edges.
spacing_and_layout.radii: rounded-none or max rounded-sm (2px) for brutalist precision.

components.buttons: Flat, 1px border, transparent background, text-white. Hover state: bg-white/5. Primary actions use text-cyan-400.
components.sliders: For EQ: Vertical orientation. Thin 2px track (bg-white/10), sharp rectangular thumb, active track colored primary (#06B6D4).
components.tabs: Full width, equal grid, text-zinc-400. Active state: text-cyan-400 with a bottom 2px border of cyan-400.
components.cards: Cardless design. Use simple divs with border-b border-white/10 and p-4 for list items.
components.badges: Small monospace tags for audio formats (e.g., [FLAC], [DSD], [64-BIT]) with border-cyan-500/30 text-cyan-400 bg-cyan-500/10.

icons.style: Duotone or bold weights for technical controls. Install command: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react

Now_Playing_Screen.layout: Hero section with large square album art (max 50vh height).
Now_Playing_Screen.audiophile_details: Below album art: Technical mono-spaced readout of bit-rate (e.g. 'FLAC 192kHz / 24bit', 'Bit-Perfect').
Now_Playing_Screen.visuals: Main playback controls centered. Audio spectrum visualizer (Recharts bar/area or animated SVG) behind or directly below controls, mapped in primary color.

Parametric_Equalizer.layout: Multiple vertical sliders for bands (e.g. 31Hz, 62Hz, 125Hz... up to 16kHz) in a horizontally scrollable container (overflow-x-auto).
Parametric_Equalizer.data_display: Each slider must have a small monospace label for Hz at the bottom, and a dynamic dB value at the top.
Parametric_Equalizer.controls: Include explicit toggles/buttons for 'Pre-amp', 'Tone', and 'Stereo Delivery' at the top of the EQ view.

Library_Panels.layout: Tabs for Playlists, Artists, Songs, Genres. Use strict list views (flex-row, items-center).
Library_Panels.items: Small square thumbnails, bold title, muted subtitle, and file format indicator badge on the right side.

Audio_Quality_Analyzer.layout: A dedicated modal or section showing a real-time Recharts-based spectrum area chart, mapping frequencies, to emulate the 'Neutron Player' complex visualizer.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard HTML/Tailwind and customized Shadcn components.
File extensions must be .js or .jsx (DO NOT use .tsx).
Ensure all numbers, times, frequencies, and bit-rates use the 'font-mono' class coupled with the imported IBM Plex Mono font.
Implement a fixed bottom navigation bar (sticky bottom-0) for switching between 'Library', 'Now Playing', 'EQ', and 'Settings'.
For the EQ sliders, stack them vertically but arrange the band groups horizontally using 'flex gap-4 overflow-x-auto p-4'.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to ALL interactive elements (buttons, tabs, sliders, list items).
Ensure hover states and active states are distinct, prioritizing high contrast (#06B6D4) over subtle greys.
Do not add any authentication or login screens. Local use only.
